description:
Solaris is our flagship Reynolds 853 steel hardtail. Light, lively and fast. XC, Trail, Up Hill, Down Dale.
We've been chasing the perfect steel hardtail since 2003, when our first bike, the Soul, redefined the genre. Solaris is where two decades of development have led.
There's a particular feeling you get on a well-built steel hardtail, a rhythm between you and the trail that full-suspension can smooth away. Solaris is built around that feeling. Refined, supple, subtle, engaging.
Reynolds 853 steel and Cotic Longshot handling means this isn't a compromise bike or a nostalgia trip. It's a seriously capable machine that happens to remind you why you started riding.
Built on Experience
More than twenty years of iteration, rider feedback, and quiet obsession with getting steel hardtails right have gone into it. Solaris is built from Reynolds 853, a proprietary heat-treated steel that is stronger than standard cromoly steel tube. This makes the frame lighter and more compliant without losing the toughness steel is known for. It's hand made in the Czech Republic. Solaris is simply the best hardtail we have ever built.
Colour Availability - We have the last few Limestone coloured frames in stock now.

Key details

Large diameter, thinwall, air hardening Reynolds 853 steel front triangle with signature Ovalform top tube
44mm standard head tube designed with external bottom cup for tapered steerer compatibility and zero stack top cup for minimal stack height
Taper butted Reynolds 853 seat tube, with a neat integrated seat binder
31.6mm seatpost size is dropper seatpost compatible, with internal "Stealth" routing
Signature Cotic 4130 cromo wishbone stay rear end. Bridge-less S-bend chainstays with Cotic Hexten gussets for improved fatigue life and massive tyre clearance
Bosses all along the down tube at 64mm bottle cage spacing for maximum luggage and cage flexibility. These also double as cable/hose routing points
Triple bottle/anything cage bosses under the down tube for extra bottle or keg capacity
Boost148 thru axle rear end, added wheel stiffness and clearance for 29 x 2.5" tyres
Minimum 100mm travel forks or 483mm rigid. Maximum 130mm travel fork
Cotic Longshot Geometry brings balance, composure, fun and speed
Five sizes, C1 to C5, designed to be compact and chuckable
